mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FACILITY_TAGS (TAG_ID, CODE, ACTIVE, ISSUED_AT, FACILITY_ID) VALUES (#{tagId}, #{code}, 'Y', SYSTIMESTAMP, #{facilityId})
mapper.select: SELECT TAG_ID, CODE, ACTIVE, ISSUED_AT, REVOKED_AT, FACILITY_ID FROM FACILITY_TAGS WHERE FACILITY_ID = #{facilityId} AND ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY ISSUED_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE FACILITY_TAGS SET ACTIVE='N', REVOKED_AT=SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE FACILITY_ID=#{facilityId} AND ACTIVE='Y'
